name: Kombai
summary: AI agent specialized in front-end code from designs.
description: Kombai turns Figma designs or screenshots into clean front-end code such as React and Tailwind, reusing the project's existing components. It works inside your code editor.
features: Figma designs or screenshots to front-end code

howToUse.title: Sign up on Kombai
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Maquettes Figma ou captures vers code front-end
summary_fr: Agent IA spécialisé dans le code front-end à partir de maquettes.
description_fr: Kombai transforme des maquettes Figma ou des captures en code front-end propre (React, Tailwind…), en respectant les composants existants du projet. Il fonctionne dans l'éditeur de code.
